summary.en-US: Arc-style auto-archive for Zen and Firefox: automatically closes tabs you haven't used in a while and keeps them in a searchable archive.

description.en-US: Miss Arc's auto-archive in Zen or Firefox? Attic closes the tabs you haven't looked at in a while and keeps them in a searchable archive, so your sidebar stays clean without losing anything. Features • Auto close idle tabs after 1 hour, 12 hours, 1 day, 7 days or 30 days • Searchable archive in the toolbar popup: type a few words, press Enter, the tab is back • Tabs reopen in the container they came from • "Keep this tab open" for single tabs, plus a list of sites that are never closed • Pinned tabs, the active tab and tabs playing audio are never closed • Private windows are left alone and never stored Private by design Everything stays in the extension's local storage. No network requests, no data collection, no account. Open source (MIT): https://github.com/davideimola/attic
